headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 29, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory, and the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 2-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Minnesota Twins left-handed pitcher Kendry Rojas, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have also placed right-handed pitcher Kenley Jansen on the 15-day injured list due to pelvic inflammation.

The Detroit Tigers made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in South Side Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 6-2 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the Twins' offense with 3 RBIs. Davis Martin earned the win for the White Sox, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 2-1, securing a crucial win on the road. Andrés Giménez led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Jeff Hoffman earned the win in relief.

top_news.title: **Twins Place Rojas on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins left-handed pitcher Kendry Rojas has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to May 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.
